current_evidence: The link resolves to Brent's current 'Validation list for: Applications for Full Planning Permission, Outline Planning Permission or Technical Details Consent', which includes post-February 2024 BNG wording. Brent publishes this list as one of a set of per-application-type lists (Householder, Reserved Matters, etc.). Neither the PDF text nor the pages fetched give an adoption date, and planning.data.gov.uk records Brent's Local List with start date 2024-01-01.

issues.detail: List date 2025-09-01 is taken from the PDF metadata CreationDate, not from the document. The list text has no adoption or publication date, so the date is unsupported. planning.data.gov.uk gives a start date of 2024-01-01 for Brent's Local List.
issues.evidence: Reference row Date basis: 'PDF metadata CreationDate'; the PDF text has no version or adoption date, and the only dates are the BNG commencement dates (February/April 2024).

issues.detail: Grokbot read only the Full/Outline/Technical Details Consent list and set every other application type to '(none) ... national requirements only'. Brent publishes separate validation lists per application type. The Householder list has 15 local requirements: Archaeological impact statement (archaeological priority areas), Basement impact assessment (any basement), CIL additional information form (100 sq m+ or a new dwelling), Contaminated land survey, Demolition plan (significant demolition), Ecological assessment, Flood risk assessment (Flood Zones 2/3), Heritage statement (listed buildings, conservation areas, Article 4 areas, locally listed buildings), Landscape plan (all applications), Noise/vibration assessment (new plant), Photographs of the site (all applications), Site plan, Site survey (level changes or basements), Tree survey (works affecting trees) and plans/drawings. Reserved Matters also has its own list, but Grokbot shows '(none)'.
issues.evidence: https://www.brent.gov.uk/media/16421113/applications-for-householder-planning-permission.pdf - 'Validation list for: Applications for Householder Planning Permission'; https://www.brent.gov.uk/media/16421115/reserved-matters-applications.pdf

issues.detail: About 12 rows and most tab_items come from a haveyoursay.brent.gov.uk consultation-draft upload (signed, expiring S3 link), not the adopted list. These include Employment Land Assessment, Heritage statement, Retail Impact Assessment, Viability Assessment (Fast Track Route text), Servicing/refuse plan, Water efficiency, Marketing evidence (24-month test), Tree survey, Advertisement illumination, Highways and Landscape plan. Draft consultation text should not be presented as the adopted requirement.

The adopted Full/Outline list has about 61 local items, but Grokbot captured roughly half. Missing or not captured as their own rows: Accommodation with shared facilities management plan (HMOs, student and co-living); Air Quality Neutral (majors outside Growth Areas/AQFAs); Air Quality Positive (majors in Growth Areas/AQFAs); Amenity space quality statement (all residential); Archaeological impact statement (APAs); Basement impact assessment (any basement); BREEAM pre-assessment (majors with 1,000 sq m+ non-residential); Circular Economy Statement (GLA-referable); Construction Logistics Plan (all majors); Decarbonisation plan (connection to a district heat network); Delivery and Servicing Management Plan (all majors); Digital connectivity infrastructure plan (new residential and commercial); Digital model (all majors); Education facilities report (loss of education or childcare facilities); Energy strategy (all majors); Foul sewage and utilities assessment (large-scale majors); Healthy Streets assessment (S278 or highway works over £200k); Lighting assessment; Meanwhile Feasibility Study/Use Strategy (phased majors in town centres or growth areas); Noise and vibration impact assessment; Noise Management Plan; Odour Management Plan; Overheating assessment (new dwellings); Parking Design and Management Plan (majors with 12+ spaces); Photographs (all applications); Planning Fire Safety Statement/Reasonable Exception Statement (all non-major applications); Topographic survey (majors and large minors); Play and informal recreation strategy (new residential); Public house supporting information; Site survey; Social Infrastructure report; Townscape/visual impact assessment; Transport Assessment incl. Travel Plan (all majors); Transport Statement (large-scale minors); TV/Radio reception assessment (30 m+); Urban Greening Factor (majors and minor residential); Water quality statement; Whole Life-Cycle Carbon Assessment (GLA-referable).
issues.evidence: e.g. 'Parking Design and Management Plan ... major developments with 12 or more off-street parking spaces'; 'Planning Fire Safety Statement or Reasonable Exception Statement ... all non-major applications'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts were read across the wrong table cells, so they describe a different requirement. Affordable Housing Statement shows the shared-facilities management plan trigger ('developments with shared facilities and/or additional support'); the actual trigger is major residential, large-scale PBSL and PBSA. Contaminated Land and Daylight/Sunlight both show the CIL trigger ('For all CIL liable applications including: 100 sqm or more...'). Tall buildings/Wind shows the TV/Radio Reception trigger. 'Ground investigation / Basement Impact Assessment' shows the archaeology trigger. 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space' shows the air pollution trigger. 'Design Code / Masterplan / Parameter plans' shows the Urban Greening Factor, ventilation and water quality rows; the source has no design code requirement. Ventilation/Extraction shows the Odour Management Plan trigger. Energy/Sustainability shows the SCI/sustainability/SuDS run-on. Open space shows only the fragment 'amenity and play space will be provided.'
issues.evidence: Source: 'Contaminated land survey: sites identified as contaminated or near a contaminated site'; 'Wind microclimate assessment: tall buildings (30 m+) or proposals likely to adversely affect wind conditions'; 'Affordable Housing Statement: major residential schemes, large-scale purpose-built shared living, and purpose-built student accommodation'

issues.detail: The 'Fire Statement' row shows the EIA trigger text and refers to the national Gateway One fire statement, which the source says is not required for outline applications. The local Planning Fire Safety Statement for non-major applications is missing. The Design and Access Statement excerpt ('Conservation Area Design and Access Statement But it is not required for: Section 73 applications') is garbled and leaves out the actual triggers (majors, LBC, dwellings or 100 sq m+ in conservation areas).
issues.evidence: Fire Statement excerpt: '...Applications that are subject to Environmental Impact Assessment in circumstances set out in the Town and Country Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations 2017.'

issues.detail: Several rows share the same excerpt: CIL form, Contaminated Land and Daylight/Sunlight; Energy/Sustainability and Statement of Community Involvement; Air Quality and 'Sunlight to gardens'; Environmental Statement and Fire Statement. Every Full planning row is also copied unchanged to Outline.
issues.evidence: Repeated excerpt: 'Decarbonisation plan For all CIL liable applications including: 100 sqm or more of new floorspace, including extensions;'

issues.detail: Outline rows copy the Full planning set wholesale, including Gateway One fire statement (not required for outline) and detailed floor/roof/elevation plans (indicative only for outline with reserved matters). Listed building consent is '(none)' even though the list's Heritage statement trigger explicitly names listed building consent. Rows from the consultation draft are placed under Full planning as 'INFERRED' (e.g. Employment Land Assessment, Heritage statement, Retail Impact Assessment).
issues.evidence: DAS/plans: '(or indicative drawings in the case of an outline application where the relevant matters are reserved)'; Heritage statement: 'Listed building consent; householder and full applications affecting listed buildings...'

issues.detail: Some tab_items are process text or descriptions of other requirements, not drawing standards: '2 hard copies are required' for postal submissions; 'Data protection and our privacy notice...' (from the viewing/commenting page); and the 'Demolition plan ... Delivery and Servicing Management Plan' and '12 Play and informal recreation strategy' fragments filed under Drawing/document standards. National items (Block plan, Floor plans/Elevations, Roof plan, CIL form, BNG, EIA) are also counted as local requirements.
issues.evidence: Tab item: 'Data protection and our privacy notice Further information about how we use your personal information throughout the planning application process...'

issues.detail: The reference row's 'Planning page' is the 'viewing or commenting on planning applications' page, which does not host the validation lists. The planning.data.gov.uk documentation URL is the 'applying for planning permission' page ('what to include with the application').

summary: Grokbot's link works and is Brent's current Full/Outline/TDC validation list, but its 2025-09-01 date comes from PDF metadata and has no support in the text. Grokbot also ignored Brent's separate Householder and Reserved Matters lists, mixed in consultation-draft text, missed about 35 local items, and has many triggers taken from the wrong row.
